# Suggested Milestones

These are intended for GitHub project setup.

## MVP Foundation

Local setup, self-hosting docs, seed data, CI, and base security checks.

## Teacher Community Beta

Live Telegram smoke, first authors, first materials, community validation, and feedback issues.

## Security Hardening

Upload validation, private file access, payment webhook verification, RBAC tests, dependency scanning, and backup restore.

## Open Source Launch

Public docs, AGPL license, README screenshots, contributor onboarding, issue backlog, and first beta tag.

## Codex for OSS Application

Application text, maintainer workload explanation, public proof of community demand, and clear Codex task examples.
